article.title: Michael Jackson – They Don’t Care About Us (Prison Version) (Official Video)
article.author: Editor
article.content: Spike Lee directed two short films for Michael Jackson’s “They Don’t Care About Us.” This version was filmed in a prison and was aired only at certain hours due to controversial content.
